title: Resumable Iterator (multi-part)
description_html:
Build an iterator whose position can be saved and restored, then extend it to more complex sources.

Levels

  1. Part 1: list iterator
    • Iterate a list; get_state() / set_state(state) resume from a saved point
  2. Part 2: multi-file iterator
    • Iterate across several files using a per-file iterator; empty files must be skipped; the state must resume mid-file
  3. Part 3: async
    • An async version of the same iterator
  4. Part 4: nested
    • Extend to 2D and 3D nested lists

Progressive round: each level unlocks after the previous one passes. Write level 1 so later levels extend it rather than rewrite it.

Source: 1point3acres OpenAI reports ("Iterator Design Challenges", six-part variant). Candidate-reported; exact wording varies between reports.
